description.en: Section titles come from Isoprene; the HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm figures stay the printed ones. HBT8018 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. The straight-pipe spare is quoted from the delivery-pipe page after model, this diameter, length and quantity. Wall thickness is not printed.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Isoprene》，HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的数字仍是已印数字。HBT8018 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。直管在输送管页按型号、这一直径、长度和数量报价。壁厚没有印出。

h1.en: Isoprene headings over the HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm catalogue line
h1.zh: 《Isoprene》的标题盖在HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的目录行上

directAnswer.en: The short answer for HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Isoprene is the outline those cells are filed under. HBT8018 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. The straight-pipe spare is quoted from the delivery-pipe page after model, this diameter, length and quantity. Wall thickness is not printed.
directAnswer.zh: HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Isoprene》是这些格子所依的大纲。 HBT8018 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。直管在输送管页按型号、这一直径、长度和数量报价。壁厚没有印出。

body.en: Where the source outline says “History and etymology”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The sheet prints motor 132 kW, output 60 m³/h, pumping pressure 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, size 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm, weight 6500 kg. Sharing 100 / 125 mm with HBT80-16 does not make the two pumps the same model. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h and a 120 m horizontal cell. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. Electric 80 also prints 60 m³/h and 40 MPa, but its model string is Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110 and it has no delivery-pipe diameter cell. Do not paste 100 / 125 mm onto Electric 80. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“历史与 词源”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 参数表印出电机 132 kW、输送量 60 m³/h、泵送压力 40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、输送管 100 / 125 mm、外形 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm、重量 6500 kg。与 HBT80-16 同为 100 / 125 mm，并不表示两台是同一型号。HBT80-16 印的是 50 m³/h 和水平 120 m。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。电动80也印 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa，但型号字符串是 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110，而且没有输送管内径格。不要把 100 / 125 mm 贴到电动80上。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Natural occurrences” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. HBT8018 is an HBT-series trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. The straight-pipe spare is quoted from the delivery-pipe page after model, this diameter, length and quantity. Wall thickness is not printed. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Natural occurrences”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上这一型号、它自己页面上的内径、需要的长度和数量。不要填写壁厚。 HBT8018 是邢台制造的 HBT 系列拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。直管在输送管页按型号、这一直径、长度和数量报价。壁厚没有印出。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Biological roles”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Biological roles”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Read “Industrial production” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isoprene
body.zh: 把“工业生产”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isoprene

question.en: What should an inquiry repeat for HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm under the heading “Biological roles”?
question.zh: 询价HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm时，在“来源章节：Biological roles”这一节应当重复什么？

answer.en: No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Where does the photograph sit relative to the printed HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm cells?
question.zh: 这张配图相对HBT8018 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的已印格子处于什么位置？

answer.en: No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
